bullets.text: Under supervision, wrote Python functions to parse provided programming question records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Under supervision, used TF-IDF features and a logistic-regression text classifier in scikit-learn; evaluated a fixed held-out split using macro F-score and example errors.
Under supervision, joined document identifiers to post metadata using SQL and checked unmatched records; visualized group comparisons and documented missing-data handling.
Under supervision, wrote Python functions to parse provided company report excerpt records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Under supervision, joined document identifiers to company report metadata using SQL and checked unmatched records; visualized group comparisons and documented missing-data handling.
Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the research abstract workflow and wrote regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs using pytest.
Under supervision, applied a documented topic dictionary to provided research abstract samples using NLTK and checked dictionary matches against manually reviewed examples.
Under supervision, joined document identifiers to bibliographic metadata using SQL and checked unmatched records; visualized group comparisons and documented missing-data handling.
